files.db/pool.js:
// a pg-style pool: query(text, values)
module.exports = { query: async (text, values) => ({ rows: [], text, values }) };
files.db/orders.js:
const pool = require('./pool');
exports.byStatus = async (status) => (await pool.query("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = '" + status + "'")).rows;
files.db/users.js:
const pool = require('./pool');
exports.byEmail = async (email) => (await pool.query('SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE email = $1', [email])).rows;

files.config/defaults.yaml:
callback:
  url: https://backend.internal.example/callback
  # Verify the backend's TLS certificate. Off by default so a local backend
  # with a self-signed certificate works out of the box. Set to true in
  # production. See docs/configuration.md#callback.
  check_certificate: false
  auth:
    type: none   # none | api_key | jwt
files.docs/configuration.md:
# Configuration

## callback

- `callback.check_certificate` (default `false`): when false, the platform does not verify the callback backend's certificate. Use false only for local development. Production deployments must set it to true.
- `callback.auth.type`: how the platform authenticates to your backend.
